basic_details.job_title: NMPA Assistant Manager (Marine) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited from eligible candidates possessing the requisite qualifications and experience for engagement as Assistant Manager (MW) on contract basis in this Port: Assistant Manager (MW) 01 vacancy. Application should be submitted in the enclosed prescribed format along with copies of self-attested documents (Qualification & Experience) to the Deputy Conservator, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010. The last date for receipt of applications is on or before 20-11-2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years. | The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

qualification.details: Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University. Minimum 2 years experience in Marine Industry. | Candidates having experience in the maintenance of Marine crafts and vessels. Proficient in M.S Office (Word, Excel and Power point). Candidates having work experience in Port sector.

salary_details.details: The consolidated pay for Assistant Manager (MW) on contract basis is ₹50,000/-. An increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration would be considered for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. | The tenure of the engagement shall be for a period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent. | The selected candidate shall execute a security bond, before joining to the post, on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹200/-, as per the text in the enclosed format. An amount of ₹5,000/- (Rupees Five thousand only) per month will be retained from your salary, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) and will be refunded after completion of the contract period without any interest.

selection_process: The candidates possessing requisite qualification and relevant experience will be called for interview. Eligible candidates will be called for interview through e-mail only. The date
time and venue of interview will be informed accordingly. NMPA reserves the right to fix the minimum standard / qualifying marks for selection of position.
Documents required at the time of interview:

2 recent passport size photos Proof of identify and age (PAN/ Aadhar Card) Education Qualification (All year / Semester Mark sheets & Certificates from 10th Standard onwards) Experience Certificates / Appointment Letter /Salary Slip The original documents should be submitted at the time of interview for verification.
important_instructions: The candidates shall have good health condition. The duration of working hours will be as per office hours with weekly off on Saturday & Sunday. In exigencies, he/she may require to work beyond officer hours/holidays for which no extra remuneration will be paid. For joining the post, no Travelling Allowance will be paid. TA/DA will be paid for official tour during the contract period as applicable to regular officers of equal rank in the port with the same basic pay. No office vehicle will be provided for attending duty at headquarters. Hence, you should make your own arrangement of transportation for attending duty headquarters at Panambur, Mangalore. Port accommodation will be provided subject to availability at rent as per NMPA policy, which will be deducted from the consolidated pay. In addition, allied charges such as water charges & Electricity charges shall have to be borne by occupant. The selected candidate shall not engage or enter yourself either directly or indirectly in any place, business or take up any employment in any other organization, while you are in service at NMPA. Your engagement is purely on contract basis and shall not confer you any right to lay claim for permanent absorption in the port service, against any post whatsoever.

content_sections.heading: About NMPA Assistant Manager (MW)
content_sections.text: The New Mangalore Port Authority, Marine Department, located in Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010, Karnataka, operates under administrative control to manage port services and marine craft maintenance. The authority has released notification number NMPA/ME/AM(MW)/CONT/2026/18 dated 27-10-2026 for engaging one Assistant Manager (MW) on a contract basis.

content_sections.heading: NMPA Assistant Manager (MW) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Application should be submitted in the enclosed prescribed format along with copies of self-attested documents (Qualification & Experience) to the Deputy Conservator, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University. Minimum 2 years experience in Marine Industry. Candidates having experience in the maintenance of Marine crafts and vessels. Proficient in M.S Office (Word, Excel and Power point). Candidates having work experience in Port sector.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years . The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

content_sections.heading: Monthly Remuneration and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay for Assistant Manager (MW) on contract basis is ₹50,000/-. An increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration would be considered for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. The tenure of the engagement shall be for a period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent. The selected candidate shall execute a security bond, before joining to the post, on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹200/-, as per the text in the enclosed format. An amount of ₹5,000/- (Rupees Five thousand only) per month will be retained from your salary, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) and will be refunded after completion of the contract period without any interest.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of Qualification certificates Experience certificates Age proof documents

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The candidates possessing requisite qualification and relevant experience will be called for interview. Eligible candidates will be called for interview through e-mail only. The date, time and venue of interview will be informed accordingly. NMPA reserves the right to fix the minimum standard / qualifying marks for selection of position. Documents required at the time of interview: 2 recent passport size photos Proof of identify and age (PAN/ Aadhar Card) Education Qualification (All year / Semester Mark sheets & Certificates from 10th Standard onwards) Experience Certificates / Appointment Letter /Salary Slip The original documents should be submitted at the time of interview for verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available in NMPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available post is Assistant Manager (MW) under the Marine Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy for the Assistant Manager (MW) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is on or before 20-11-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University along with a minimum of 2 years experience in Marine Industry.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay for Assistant Manager (MW) on contract basis is ₹50,000/-, with an increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q7. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format along with copies of self-attested documents (Qualification & Experience) to the Deputy Conservator, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on contract basis for an initial period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent, and shall not confer any right to lay claim for permanent absorption in the port service.
